correctness.rationale: The source defines distinct fields \(H_5\) and \(H_6\) for androgen and PSA, yet the two final printed recurrences both use \(H_5\). Subtracting those recurrences proves the invariant \(P_n-A_n=P_0-A_0\) without any assumption about the fractional weights. At the source-parameter state \(X_1=X_2=0\), \(A=a_0=10\), \(P=1\), and \(u=0\), exact arithmetic gives \(H_5=0\) and \(H_6=-0.08\). Thus the intended integer-order vector field changes \(P-A\) while the printed recurrence cannot. The correction \(H_5\mapsto H_6\) in the PSA update is componentwise and sufficient for this defect.

value.rationale: PSA is a principal observable in the biological model and one of the six time series displayed in every main simulation figure. The printed recurrence does not merely perturb its weights: it eliminates the PSA vector field entirely and forces PSA to be an affine copy of androgen. The exact invariant gives a simple reproducibility diagnostic and a one-symbol componentwise repair, while the limitation about unavailable code prevents overclaiming impact on the plotted data.
